contract_tests: paginate(range(1,8), page=2, size=2) returns [3,4] (one-based page numbering) -> test_page_two_size_two_returns_third_and_fourth asserts result == [3, 4] and isinstance(result, list).
paginate(range(1,8), page=1, size=2) returns [1,2] -> test_page_one_size_two_returns_first_two asserts result == [1, 2] and isinstance(result, list).
paginate(range(1,8), page=4, size=2) returns [7] (last partial page) -> test_last_partial_page_returns_remaining asserts result == [7] and isinstance(result, list).
paginate(range(1,8), page=5, size=2) returns [] (beyond last page) -> test_page_beyond_last_returns_empty asserts result == [] and isinstance(result, list).
Empty input returns [] -> test_empty_input_returns_empty asserts paginate([], 1, 2) == [] and isinstance(result, list).

Invalid inputs (non-positive page) return [] -> test_non_positive_page_returns_empty asserts paginate([1,2], 0, 2) == [] and test_negative_page_returns_empty asserts paginate([1,2,3], -1, 2) == [], both with isinstance(result, list).

Invalid inputs (non-positive size) return [] -> test_non_positive_page_size_returns_empty asserts paginate([1,2], 1, 0) == [] and test_negative_page_size_returns_empty asserts paginate([1,2,3], 1, -2) == [], both with isinstance(result, list).

Existing public callers of paginate continue to work with one-based semantics -> test_one_based_semantics_with_list_input asserts paginate([10,20,30,40,50], 2, 2) == [30, 40] and isinstance(result, list); existing tests/test_contract.py assertions paginate([], 1, 2) == [] and paginate([1,2], 0, 2) == [] remain satisfied.

patches.rationale: The bug is in pagination.py: `start = page * page_size` treats page numbers as zero-based, so page=2, size=2 starts at index 4 (returning [5,6]) instead of index 2 ([3,4]). Fix by computing `start = (page - 1) * page_size`, making page numbers one-based. The guard `if page < 1 or page_size < 1: return []` already preserves empty/invalid inputs and, combined with slicing, naturally returns [] for pages beyond the last page. Existing test tests/test_contract.py remains valid: paginate([], 1, 2) == [] and paginate([1,2], 0, 2) == []. A new regression test file tests/test_pagination_regression.py is added covering all acceptance contracts with exact inputs and result types.
